items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Well, Sig Norelli was around New York.

ctx.x: Steve Brown, of course, when he's missing Goldkitt. But they had dissipated by that time. There were some around Chicago, but not many in New York.
Well, Sig Norelli was around New York. Oh, yes.
Is he from New Orleans? I don't know, because I always associated him with that group.
